escalation: Start at the mapped tier. If the output fails verification or the task fails once, escalate one tier. Two failures reaches brain. Never start at brain by default: that is the overspend Da Homi exists to kill.

gateways.decision_rule: Deterministic task-class rules decide first (they cover most traffic for free). Ambiguous tasks go to the judge. Da Homi logs every routing decision to da-homi-cache/routing/ so spend can be audited against outcomes.
gateways.fallback_primitive: TypeSafe/Jev unit scoring required capability tier per task, wired into LiteLLM model groups
gateways.judge: NVIDIA Switchyard piloted on top of LiteLLM: judges request difficulty and can switch models mid-run
gateways.primary: LiteLLM self-hosted gateway: one endpoint for every agent, per-agent keys, hard budget caps, full cost log

brain.posture: only when the task earns it or two escalations have failed
brain.purpose: strategy, synthesis, hard reasoning, final judgment calls

builder.posture: escalate here when scout output is thin or the task makes things
builder.purpose: code, drafting, vetting judgments, summaries, comparisons

scout.posture: default starting tier for every task
scout.purpose: search, fetch, triage, classify, dedupe: high volume, low judgment
